findings.evidence: The public declarations at lines 288, 305, 326, 339, 355, and 364 use the shared assumptions from line 238. Mathlib provides `lintegral_dirac [MeasurableSingletonClass α]` and `aemeasurable_dirac [MeasurableSingletonClass α]`, so continuity-to-measurability via `OpensMeasurableSpace` is stronger than needed for this finite-support law.
findings.fix: Replace `[OpensMeasurableSpace X]` with `[MeasurableSingletonClass X]` and evaluate/AEMeasurably represent the two Dirac integrals using `lintegral_dirac` and `aemeasurable_dirac`.
findings.issue: All five public barycenter theorems inherit `[OpensMeasurableSpace X]`, excluding valid measurable pseudometric spaces whose measurable structure merely contains singletons.

summary: The two-point barycenter API unnecessarily requires the metric topology to be measurable, although finite Dirac-supported measures only require measurable singletons.
